review.frase.faq.q1: How does Frase's AI writer work?
review.frase.faq.a1: Frase's AI writer uses GPT technology to generate content based on your outline and SERP research. You can write paragraphs, rewrite existing text, or generate entire sections. The AI pulls context from your content brief and top-ranking pages to create relevant, on-topic content. While it produces good drafts, you should always review and edit AI-generated content for accuracy and brand voice.
review.frase.faq.q2: What's the difference between Solo and Basic plans?
review.frase.faq.a2: Solo plan ($14.99/month) includes 4 articles per month with basic AI writing capabilities and is great for occasional content creators. Basic plan ($44.99/month) includes 30 articles per month, full AI writer with advanced templates, Google Docs integration, and is ideal for regular content production. Both include unlimited searches and SERP analysis.
review.frase.faq.q3: Can Frase replace traditional keyword research tools?
review.frase.faq.a3: Frase focuses on content optimization rather than comprehensive keyword research. It doesn't provide search volume data or keyword difficulty scores. You'll still need tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, or Ubersuggest for finding keywords. Frase excels once you have target keywords - it helps you create optimized content for those keywords.
review.frase.faq.a4: Yes, Frase integrates with WordPress through a plugin (available on Basic plan and above). You can optimize content directly in WordPress or write in Frase and publish to WordPress. The platform also integrates with Google Docs, allowing you to optimize content in your preferred writing environment.
review.frase.faq.q5: How accurate is Frase's content optimization score?
review.frase.faq.a5: Frase's optimization score is generally reliable and based on analysis of top-ranking pages. However, it's not as refined as specialized tools like Clearscope or Surfer SEO. Use the score as a guide rather than an absolute measure. Focus on creating comprehensive, helpful content rather than just hitting a specific score.
review.frase.faq.q6: Is there a free trial available?
review.frase.faq.a6: Yes, Frase offers a 5-day free trial that gives you full access to all features including the AI writer, SERP analyzer, and optimization tools. The trial includes 1 article document to test the platform. No credit card is required to start the trial, making it risk-free to evaluate if Frase fits your workflow.
